ordered_review.finding: 原cancel→committed克隆保留；仅提取for-patch helper并共用admit；每patch range/revision/ownership/layout/overflow/deps、before固定迭代和split预算原字节未变
同queue+family且非host的成功prefix；任何append开始撤queue/family，非法prefix cancel；apply或admit错误无publish资格，committed不变
prepared_family新元数据在cancel和publish撤销；原host/opaque/discard/preview走cancel路径；guard仍在全部submission gates持有下，跨cell错误Drop全取消
保每个原prepare末尾cells.grow和每split scratch.grow，旧+新backing同时计费；不把原中途准入推迟到尾部。Storage::grow先capacity>=wanted返回，prepare只split不merge，容量单调，省掉的初始scratch.grow/重放旧prefix确为无新alloc的工作
每当前read仍先declared/opaque overlap，再首prepare或append前一read生成后缀，再producer/revision取自真实prepared cells，再scratch.add；不提前应用末尾patch改首错误次序
最后read后缀append成功才合并同table最终staged deps；无privateReads仍原prepare_cell；从未重排/合并私有read或伪造timelinepoint
同cpu_state_patches mutex、同native_state mutex/资源gate顺序，新增SyncCell wrapper只借既有已初始化table，不造owner/锁/缓存或跨submit保留prefix
